question: Which of the following organisations released the ‘Global Economic Freedom Index 2020 Annual Report’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Heritage Foundation**__.

__
 
• **The Heritage Foundation released the ‘Global Economic Freedom Index 2020 Annual Report’**__.

 
 
• It was the 26th edition published by Heritage Foundation.
